events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened on this day in 1969, attracting nearly half a million people.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a legendary festival kicked off, defining a generation with three days of peace and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on this day in 1977, 49 years ago.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King. Forty-nine years since we lost Elvis Presley, his music and legend continue to rock the world. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996, 30 years ago.

angles.name: Legacy of Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a legend. Remembering Tupac Shakur today and the indelible mark he left on hip-hop. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, 56 years ago.

angles.name: Remembering Hendrix
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Walk Across Abbey Road
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of 'Abbey Road'. The Beatles' final recorded album remains a masterpiece. Which track from the album is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top track from the iconic frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975, 51 years ago.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released 'Imagine' in the UK. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001, 25 years ago.

angles.name: 25 Years of iPod
angles.copy: A quarter-century ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto your iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' premiered, launching the world's most famous secret agent. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's your top Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album 58 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their eclectic 'White Album'. A double LP with so many classics. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away on this day in 1991, 35 years ago.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track from this influential record?
